explanation.owner_view: Your slab photos check out — the stage is real and the geotag matches Plot 47. The problem is the money, not the work. ₹18,00,000 has been paid out against about ₹13,90,000 of value actually standing on site, and finishing the remaining scope at today's Kompally rates would cost roughly ₹15,80,000 — about ₹5,80,000 more than what is left of the loan. That gap is why this tranche is on hold rather than released. The four questions from your contract review are the fastest way to close most of it, and the sanction check page shows three specific routes.
explanation.officer_view: HOLD recommended on tranche 3, loan 1001. Disbursed ₹18,00,000 cumulative (T1 ₹6,00,000, T2 ₹6,00,000, T3 ₹6,00,000). Verified value in place ₹13,90,000, derived from the slab stage against the BoQ schedule of values. Disbursement exposure 1.29 against a 1.00 hold threshold. Cost to complete ₹15,80,000 at current Kompally rates, leaving a ₹5,80,000 shortfall against the undrawn balance. Site evidence is strong: three photographs, geotag matched to Plot 47, timestamp 10 Aug 11:42, camera position consistent with the tranche-2 set, high confidence, no human review flag. Contract-side exposure is compounding: 9 open BoQ flags including 3 rate outliers on RCC and ₹1,54,000 of scope absent from the signed document. Benchmark source: CPWD DSR 2023 × Hyderabad factor.
